title: fix(ui): the view / page-block filter editor offers a multiple: true field membership only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XP3RHGWUG7UH3fNa4tBa9UC)_

Fixes #36169

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在工作室里给视图、页面和页面里的关联列表写筛选条件时，"多选"字段（例如可选多人的负责人字段）的运算符下拉框现在只给"包含 / 不包含 / 为空 / 不为空"，不再给保存后一定被服务端拒绝的"等于 / 属于"；单选字段不变。
- 属于"多值字段筛选"这组修复，补上条件编辑器那次修复没覆盖到的视图与页面筛选编辑器。
- 影响在工作室或应用内视图设置里写筛选的管理员；只改界面给出的选项，已存的筛选原样不动，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做的一件事：无。

## What changes

A `select` / `lookup` / `user` field declared `multiple: true` stores a list. Studio's view and page-block filter editor (`FilterBuilderField`, the `filter-builder` widget) built its field list without `multiple`, so the shared `FilterBuilder` treated such a field as single-value and offered `Equals` / `Is any of`, which the data door refuses on a list (400 `INVALID_FILTER`, measured on that door by the condition-editor half of this family, PR #36165). `FilterBuilderField` now forwards each field's `multiple` exactly as PR #36165 did for the other editors, and the builder offers `jsonColumnFilterOperators`' set (Contains, Does not contain, Is empty, Is not empty). No operator table is copied: the set is `operatorsForField`'s answer.

Measured where the field list is built (the dispatch assumed two call sites in one file): `FilterBuilderField` has three call sites in two files, and its field list is built in five places. Each now carries the served `multiple`:

| Host | Surface | Field list built by |
|---|---|---|
| generic metadata editor | a page's `interfaceConfig.filterBy`, tab presets (`filter-mode`), any form row with `widget: filter-builder` | `objectCatalogOf` in `ResourceEditPage.tsx` (extracted from the inline loader so it can be pinned) |
| Studio list-view inspector | a list view's Filter row | `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` field catalog |
| view-variant inspector | a view variant's `filter` | `ViewVariantInspector.tsx` widget context |
| in-app view configuration panel | the same inspector, fed an override catalog | `mapObjectFields` in `ViewConfigPanel.tsx` |
| page block inspector | `record:related_list` block `filter` | `FilterRulesField` in `PageBlockInspector.tsx` (already reads `useObjectFields`, which carries `multiple` since PR #36165) |

Read-back of a stored `equals` / `in` rule on a list column: this editor has no Source fallback (unlike `datasetFilterCondition`). It hands the stored rule to the builder as stored; the builder mounts the row's own operator beside the offered set (`offeredOperatorsForRow`), so the rule opens as an `Equals` row the author can change to `Contains`, and opening it writes nothing. Pinned.

Read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` — `objectCatalogOf`: the loader body moved verbatim into an exported function, plus the `multiple` projection. Check the record and array branches still read `name` the same way.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx` — the `fbFields` forward and `ObjectFieldOption.multiple`.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ViewConfigPanel.tsx` — `mapObjectFields` is now exported (marked internal, for the pin).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.filterBuilderMultiple-36169.test.tsx` — expect 12 passed.

## Tests

New file named for the card, `widgets.filterBuilderMultiple-36169.test.tsx` (no shared harness file exists for `FilterBuilderField`; its other pins are card-named files):

- the widget: a `multiple: true` user / lookup / select column's real operator dropdown equals `operatorsForField`'s labels (the four); CONTROLS: single-value user / select columns keep `Equals` and stay inside their type bucket;
- read-back: a stored `equals` rule on `owners` opens as its row, writes nothing, and its dropdown lists `Equals` plus the four;
- every host: `objectCatalogOf` (record and array forms) and `mapObjectFields` mark exactly the `multiple: true` columns; the view-variant inspector, the page block's related-list filter and the Studio list-view inspector (real `MetadataClient` over a served object) each offer a list column the four.

<details><summary>Reverse verification (one mutation per site, on the committed fix)</summary>

Each `multiple` projection was deleted in turn with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, blob moved), the file ran, and the tool restored it (`git checkout HEAD`, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- `FilterBuilderField` forward: 7 failed / 5 passed (the passing five: the helper's own answer, the two single-value controls, the two catalog unit pins);
- `objectCatalogOf`: 5 failed (the four widget cases built from that catalog, and its unit pin);
- `mapObjectFields`: 2 failed (its unit pin, the view-variant case fed by it);
- `ViewVariantInspector`: 1 failed (its case);
- `PageBlockInspector`: 1 failed (its case);
- `ObjectListViewInspector`: 1 failed (its case).

The first attempt at the `ViewVariantInspector` and `PageBlockInspector` mutations deleted the closing brackets with the spread and failed to transform ("no tests"): void, not counted; redone with an anchor on the spread alone.
</details>

<details><summary>Affected suites</summary>

At `903d9ca0` (the final head `b8e29a32` adds one module-top import to the new test file): `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the existing suites of every edited component (`widgets*`, `ResourceEditPage*`, `ViewConfigPanel*`, `PageBlockInspector*`, `ViewVariantInspector*`, `ObjectListViewInspector*`, `ListView*`, `StudioDesignSurface.listViewInspector*`, `viewFilterOrGroup*`, `WidgetContext*`, `SchemaForm*`) → Test Files 137 passed (137), Tests 933 passed (933). The new file at `b8e29a32`: 12 passed (12). The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite is CI's (`Test UI`).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Reach, borrowed not re-measured:** the refusal of `$eq` / `$in` on a list column at the data door is PR #36165's measurement on the same door (showcase, SqlDriver). This PR measures the Studio offer only (the pins above); no backend was booted.
- **Sibling drop, not fixed here:** the generic editor's catalog (`objectCatalogOf`), the view-variant inspector and the page block's `FilterRulesField` also leave out each field's `options`, which the list-view inspector carries (the objectstack#27515 picklist value picker). On those hosts a picklist column gets a free-text value box. Not this card's mechanism (`multiple`), not measured in a running app; listed in the report.
- `ObjectFieldOption` gains an optional `multiple`; the `field-ref` / `field-multi` pickers read name, label and type only, so they are unchanged.
